thread:
anika: Quick follow-up from the postmortem yesterday — we surfaced three recurring patterns for streaming/chat: timeouts during long responses, partial/short chunking (clients seeing truncated output), and brittle reconnects when load spikes. Need owners + short runbook items.

pete: I'll take reconnect logic and retry-window tuning. Plan: widen jittered backoff + make reconnect idempotent for open streams. Target: Wed EOD.

aj: I'll own partial-response detection and the telemetry. Proposal: add `partial_chunk_rate` and `avg_final_chunk_delay` to the streaming metrics and emit a trace tag when a stream closes without EOS. Will sketch a DataDog dashboard. ETA Tue afternoon.

maria: I'll coordinate a canary with the mobile SDKs and the web client to validate reconnect flows and offline resumes. Also will run network throttling tests for 3 regions. ETA Thu.

sam: I'll take timeouts — evaluate whether current 30s token-timeout is too aggressive for long generations. Hypothesis: extend token timeout to 90s for pinned long-running models + add per-route overrides. Can prototype change in dev by tomorrow.

anika: Thanks. Can we capture the concrete action items here (owner, what, due)? I'll ping the postmortem doc after.

pete: Action items: 
- pete: make reconnect idempotent + add backoff config (owner: pete) — due 2023-11-08
- aj: add `partial_chunk_rate` metric + trace tag + dashboard — due 2023-11-07
- sam: route-level token-timeout overrides + default bump to 90s for long-gen models — due 2023-11-06
- maria: canary plan + network-throttle test matrix (EU/US/APAC) — due 2023-11-09

ops-bot: deploybot: scheduled runbook job created: `streaming/reconnect-config-2023-11-08` — job id run-7791

anika: Also a couple of quick engineering decisions we made during the PM: 1) prefer client-driven resume (client supplies last-good-kv-index) over server-side buffered replays; 2) if reconnects exceed 3 within 5m, surface an incident alert to `#eng-oncall`.

aj: For the telemetry, I'll attach an example span attribute: `stream.eos_received: true|false` and emit `stream.final_chunk_size` in bytes. That should help distinguish partial truncation vs deliberate close.

pete: Pseudo-config I'll apply to the runtime (will refine in PR):
```
reconnect: {
  max_retries: 5,
  base_backoff_ms: 150,
  max_backoff_ms: 5000,
  jitter: full,
  idempotency_token: stream_resume_id
}
```

maria: Quick note: mobile SDKs may retry aggressively by default — I will lock clients to honor server `Retry-After` and add a flag `sdk.defer_reconnect=true` for experimentation.

sam: On timeouts, I'm adding a per-route config: `token_timeout_ms` default 30000, override for `/v1/streams/long-gen` = 90000. We'll gate via feature flag for 2 weeks.

anika: Good. We also want an operational verification checklist for the rollout:
- update runtime config (pete)
- add metrics & dashboard (aj)
- feature-flagged deploy for token timeout (sam)
- mobile+web canary (maria)
- run smoke traffic for 24h, then promote (ops)

aj: I'll create the dashboard and add an alert: `partial_chunk_rate > 0.5% for 10m` -> page oncall.

pete: I'll add an automated test that fuzzes socket disconnect/reconnects at the worker level to ensure idempotent resumes. Will push a draft PR today.

ops-bot: incidentbot: reminder set for 2023-11-10 09:00 UTC — "streaming reliability follow-up sync"

maria: One more ask: can someone from support provide a list of customer-facing incidents where partial responses were reported (last 90d)? That will help prioritize routes. @support?

anika: I'll loop in support after posting this thread to the PM doc. Also recommending we run a weekly 15-min "streaming signal review" for 6 weeks to track regression patterns. If we see >2 regressions, escalate to emergency sprint.

sam: sounds good :thumbsup:

pete: ack :thumbsup:

aj: I'll attach the dashboard link here when ready: <https://dashboards.internal/datadog/streaming-partial-chunk>

anika: Thanks all. I'll capture these in the postmortem follow-up and assign owners in the action tracker. If anyone needs to change ETA ping me.

sam: one last note — let's also record the test harness used for long sequences (config blob) so we can replay failing cases. I'll add to the PR.

pete: +1. good call.

ops-bot: deploybot: config change `reconnect` staged in canary, run id run-7791. Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/run-7791/logs

anika: closing loop here. Will post action-tracker link in the PM doc and create calendar for weekly check-ins. :white_check_mark:
